hero.headline: The Data Warehouse for Global AI
hero.subheadline: Compute is only half the battle. We provide the ultra-fast storage infrastructure needed to feed data-hungry LLMs and computer vision models.

sections.title: Eliminating the Data Bottleneck
sections.body: Modern AI training requires massive throughput between storage arrays and GPU memory. If your data isn't close to your compute, your expensive GPUs sit idle, waiting for I/O operations. Kenya AI Compute has dedicated 20% of its facility capacity to high-speed storage. Our architecture utilizes an NVMe-over-Fabric (NVMe-oF) design, allowing our GPU clusters to access datasets at local-bus speeds across the 100G internal network. We also maintain a local repository of the world's most popular open-source datasets (Common Crawl, LAION, Pile), pre-formatted and ready for instant mounting. This saves researchers days of download time and ensures that every second of rented GPU time is spent on actual computation, not waiting for data to arrive from across the ocean. sections.title: Storage Capabilities
items: Throughput: 100G internal fabric ensures zero I/O wait times for training nodes.
Hybrid Tiers: NVMe 'Hot' storage for active training and HDD 'Cold' storage for archiving.
Pre-loaded Library: Instant access to major open-source datasets for immediate fine-tuning.
Security: Fully encrypted at-rest and in-transit data protection protocols.
Scalability: Support for S3-compatible object storage to handle petabyte-scale data lakes.
